blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Forced outage of two major coal-fired power plant and limited import from Mindanao grid resulted to a yellow alert in the Visayas grid from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. on Thursday. In an advisory, the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) said Unit 3 of Panay Energy Development Corporation (PEDC) and Unit 1 of the Kepco SPC Power Corporation (KSPC) are unavailable to date. Electricity import from Mindanao is also affected due to the unplanned outage of the Unit 3 of FDC Misamis Power Corporation and the scheduled maintenance works for Unit 4 of GNPower Kauswagan and […]...
